source_unchanged: Frozen joint v1 code/protocol not modified; no new measured fit run by reviewer

primary_uncertainty_source.section: II OGLE-only Model, paragraph beginning First, we correct the photometric uncertainties
primary_uncertainty_source.interpretation: Authors empirically corrected pipeline errors to match observed scatter by magnitude/detector; median new-reduction error11mmag and diagonal reducedchi2 nearunity. No GP-white/conditional variance decomposition is provided. Treating suppliedsigmas as total reported marginal scatter is better motivated than assuming they exclude all correlated variance; neither covariance structure is supplied or certified.
primary_uncertainty_source.scope_limit: This supports testing a variance-preserving correlation allocation; it does not prove that all corrected errors are exact source-specific marginals or identify temporal covariance.

M0.conclusion: Scalar variance screen passes, but residual serial dependence prevents a reliable independent-noise uncertainty claim. Correlation can reflect noise or a deficient deterministic mean, not uniquely new physics.

M1.conclusion: Upper-tail-only NOT_REJECTED label misses severe lower-tail underdispersion. The additive-D-plus-OU family is not an adequate calibrated noise description here. Diagonal double-counting is a plausible structural explanation, not established as sole cause.
M1.caution: Post-fit chi-square distribution is approximate with fitted covariance. Twenty local parametric refits provide coarse diagnostics only; neither6.9e-33 nor1/21 is an exact globally calibrated pvalue.

prospective_candidate.status: Proposed after v1 diagnostics; freeze separately before v2 measured fits, not external or whole-study preregistration
prospective_candidate.domain: 0<=f<=fmax<1; tau>0; preserve all native sigmas and rows
prospective_candidate.objective: Q+logdet(R), Q=(r/sigma_native)^T R^-1(r/sigma_native); nativeD determinant is parameter-independent baseline
prospective_candidate.transformed_covariance: L0 R L0^T tridiagonal: firstdiag1, subsequentdiag1+(1-2f)*a_i^2, subdiag-(1-f)*a_i
prospective_candidate.determinant: det(L0)=1, so logdetR=2sum(log(diag(chol(tridiagonal)))); it is generally negative
prospective_candidate.least_squares_option: If retaining least_squares, add residualsqrt(logdetR-N*log(1-fmax)); fixed positive offset must be reported/subtracted consistently. Do notsqrt(logdetR) or clamp it tozero.
prospective_candidate.existing_helper_correction: OU helper on normalized residuals with whitesigma=sqrt(1-f), amplitude=sqrt(f) returns logdetR-Nlog(1-f); addNlog(1-f). Atf=0 use exactdiagonal branch.
prospective_candidate.boundary: f=0 is legitimate null; tau then unidentified. No automatic Wilks coverage.

required_prospective_stopping_rules: Retain every v1 outcome and explicit diagnostic failure; never select covariance by closeness to published mass
Pin new model, bounds, data, search/controls and code before first new measured fit
Use both lower/upper innovation variance diagnostics and residual time/season/seeing/brightness/error-bin checks; qualify multiplicity and finite MonteCarlo resolution
Generate/refit controls from the exact proposed normalizedcovariance, not v1 additivecovariance; retain failures in denominator
Mass profiling must retain competing admitted modes and numerical-cap failures; uncertainty support levels remain conditional
Complete clock, exposure-window/weight, filter correlation/jitter/frame-prior/lens-light, data-window and ephemeris sensitivities
If main model or any material admissible sensitivity lacks adequate residuals or mass support, report conditional/unresolved result rather than reliable recovery
Known-system mass support plus external darkness/single-lens evidence may support a conditional benchmark interpretation; this never creates a new-object discovery
